references.text: Parallel text describing the original instructions for making two gold rings and placing them on the two ends of the breastpiece, at the edge facing the ephod.
Continuation of the instructions on how the breastpiece was to be attached to the ephod using gold rings and blue cords.
The immediate context describing the other gold rings and chains made to attach the breastpiece to the ephod.
The continuation describing two more gold rings and how the breastpiece was tied to the ephod with a blue cord.
Another example of gold rings used in the sanctuary's equipment, here on the ark of the covenant, showing a similar design pattern.
